passive.name: Flame-Devouring Choir
passive.text: Increases CRIT Rate by **20/23/26/29/32%**. When the equipper triggers an **Aftershock** that deals **Fire DMG**, their attacks ignore **15/17.2/19.5/21.7/24%** of the target's DEF for 8s. Can stack once every 3s, up to 2 stacks. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: String & Melody
passive.text: CRIT DMG increases by **50/57.5/65/72.5/80%**. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, they gain 1 stack of **Heartstring**. Each stack of **Heartstring** allows the equipper's **Chain Attack** and **Ultimate** to ignore **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%** of the target's **Fire RES**, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Tranquil Blossom
passive.text: CRIT DMG is increased by **30/34.5/39/43.5/48%**. When the equipper lands a hit with a **Basic Attack**, **Special Attack**, or **Aftershock**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's **Electric DMG** increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

passive.name: False Personas
passive.text: Increases CRIT DMG by **45/51.75/58.5/65.25/72%**. When using an **EX Special Attack**, **Chain Attack**, or **Ultimate** to deal **Ice DMG**, the equipper gains the **Absolute Zero Death Sentence** effect for 3s. While **Absolute Zero Death Sentence** is active, the character ignores **25/28.75/32.5/36.25/40%** of the enemy's DEF when landing a hit.

passive.name: Sprouting Core
passive.text: Increases CRIT Rate by **15/17/19/21/23%**. When the equipper deals DMG with a **Basic Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's **Electric DMG** by **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%**, up to 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 40s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Can trigger once per use of a skill. At 2 stacks, the wearer's **Basic Attack** and **Ultimate** DMG ignore **20/23/26/29/32%** of enemy DEF.

passive.name: Extraordinary Anti-Theft Measures
passive.text: ATK increases by **6/6.9/7.8/8.7/9.6**%, and DMG dealt by **EX Special Attacks** increases by **15/17.2/19.5/21.8/24%**.

passive.name: Get Everyone Fired Up
passive.text: When an **EX Special Attack** or **Chain Attack** hits an enemy, the equipper's ATK increases by **6/6.9/7.8/8.7/9.6%** for 8s. While the target is under an Attribute Anomaly, this effect is increased by an additional **6/6.9/7.8/8.7/9.6%**.

substatLine: CRIT DMG = CRIT Rate > ATK% > PEN > ATK
skillPriority: Special Attack > Chain Attack > Assist > Basic Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, followed by a powerful flame blade strike, dealing **Physical DMG** and **Fire DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge: Flickering Flames
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Rush Command
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Counter Strike Opportunity
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG** and **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Searing Slash
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG** and **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Blazing Gunblade
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Boiling Pierce
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Unleash multiple attacks against enemies in front, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Blazing Chamber
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Thrust forward and perform a tail attack, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Corrosive Flash
entries.text:
Automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Unleashes 4 laser Aftershock attacks, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Triggers once per 5s.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Perform a sweeping laser attack forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.
After using this skill, immediately follow up with the powerful fire blade from the Basic Attack.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex
entries.text:
When off-field with 60 or more Energy, automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Performs a sweeping laser attack in an area around, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Heat Charge
entries.text:
When Bottled Heat is greater than or equal to 100, hold Special Attack to activate:
Consume 100 Bottled Heat to continuously fire a laser forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.
When firing begins, triggers **Quick Assist**.
After continuous firing for a period, firepower increases, greatly boosting the skill's Interrupt Level.
When attacked during firing, will parry enemy attacks and immediately increase firepower.
When maximum firing duration is reached, automatically activates EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption.
During the low firepower phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 40%, while character is invulnerable during the high firepower phase.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption
entries.text:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Heat Charge reaches maximum firing time:
Performs a spinning attack forward, then fires a laser ahead dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 points of Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Dance With Fire
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing **Fire DMG**.
When leaping into the air, a **Quick Assist** will be triggered. If the **Quick Assist** is activated, Orphie & Magus will extend the laser firing duration.
Upon activating this skill, recover 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Taming Wind and Fire
entries.text:
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by **25%**, and Aftershock DMG increases by **85%**.
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by **280**. When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed **700**. When an Agent with Zeroed In triggers Aftershock, their Zeroed In duration extends by 4s, up to a maximum extension of 20s.
The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Forged in Flames
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Stun** or **Support** character:
Aftershock DMG dealt by Agents with Zeroed In ignores 25% DEF.

entries.name: Luxurious Cat House
entries.text:
Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's **Fire RES**,
and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.

entries.name: Weird Food List
entries.text:
When Orphie & Magus launch an Aftershock, restore 65 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 4s.
After Orphie & Magus use their Ultimate, their ATK increases by 20% for up to 45s.

entries.name: "Tactics Manual"
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Pink Holster
entries.text: Initial duration of Zeroed In increases to 16s, and Orphie & Magus's EX Special Attack: Heat Charge and Ultimate: Dance With Fire DMG increases by 40%.

entries.name: Ferry Toll
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Magic Seed
entries.text:
With enough energy, after the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, press EX Special Attack to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex.
When the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower is activated, recover 10 Bottled Heat, and the Interrupt Level during the low firepower phase of EX Special Attack: Heat Charge will also increase.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge or Ultimate hits enemies, it deals additional **Fire DMG** equal to 250% of Orphie & Magus's ATK.
This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and is counted as EX Special Attack and Aftershock DMG.
